en: Colorized panoramic view of a historic European town nestled in a valley surrounded by steep, terraced mountains. The foreground shows dense urban fabric with red-tiled roofs, church towers, and tree-lined streets; in the upper right corner is printed the caption "Trient, Panorama." A green postage stamp with German text and a postmark is affixed near the top center.
